title: kith-store: pre-V8 contacts misclassified as created after V13 migration
description: upsert() uses created_at_counter=0 as a sentinel meaning "just inserted". The V13 migration sets created_at_counter=changed_at_counter WHERE changed_at_counter>0. A contact that existed before V8 with state counter=0 has both changed_at_counter=0 and created_at_counter=0 after V13. The first update to such a contact stamps created_at_counter=N (>0), causing get_changes_since_ordered to return is_create=true for an existing contact. RFC 8620 clients will treat an existing contact as newly created. Fix: use -1 as the unset sentinel, or add an is_inserted boolean column set exactly once at INSERT time.
